core.headline: Two-bedroom maisonette with own entrance, Streatham High Road
core.listing:
A two-bedroom leasehold maisonette over the first and second floors with its own entrance, on Streatham High Road. The property has a bay-fronted living room and a kitchen fitted in 2022. A section 42 lease extension notice has been served and can be assigned to the buyer.

The first floor offers a living room measuring 4.90m x 4.10m into bay (16'1" x 13'5" into bay) with a bay window to the front, and a kitchen measuring 3.20m x 2.30m (10'6" x 7'7"). On the second floor you will find bedroom one measuring 3.85m x 3.05m (12'8" x 10'0"), bedroom two measuring 2.70m x 2.40m (8'10" x 7'10"), and a bathroom.

Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit, and there is a shared bin store. There is no parking; pay-and-display is available on adjoining roads.

Streatham station is approx. 6 minutes' walk, and Streatham Common is approx. 10 minutes' walk.

Offers in Excess of £375,000. Leasehold with 89 years remaining; ground rent £350 per year (doubles every 25 years; next increase 2034); service charge £960 per year (y/e Dec 2025, includes buildings insurance). Council Tax Band C. EPC rating D. The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road, and there is some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below. There is a right of access via the rear service yard shared with the commercial unit, and a shared bin store. Chain involved.
core.summary: Own entrance to a first and second floor maisonette on Streatham High Road, with a bay-fronted living room, kitchen fitted 2022, and a section 42 lease extension notice served that can be assigned to the buyer.
